name: Indiana University Columbus
tuition_note: In-state (Indiana resident) full-time undergraduate tuition & fees for 2025-26 from columbus.iu.edu/admissions/affordability-aid/tuition-fees.html (updated 8/19/2025). Per-semester resident banded tuition $4,758.96 + student services fee $621.92 + general education program fee $118.00 = $5,498.88/semester x 2 = $10,997.76/year. Housing: IU Columbus (formerly IUPUC) is a commuter campus with no on-campus residence halls; no official room/housing cost is published, so housing_cost is null.
